package.name: il_dataset
package.description: Imitation-Learning Dataset Collection — two-level navigation expert: a 5 Hz macro expert (DIRECT_GUIDE / SIDE_GUIDE / OBSERVE / GOAL_REACHED / FAILED) and a 30 Hz local expert (observed-map A* + B-spline trajectory optimization). C++ handles all map, search and optimization loops; Python owns episode lifecycle, 5/30 Hz scheduling, recording and low-frequency decisions. Collects via AvoidBench Unity / Flightmare.
